ruleDefinitions.name: Process Proxy Execution Via Squirrel.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the usage of the "Squirrel.exe" binary to execute arbitrary processes. This binary is part of multiple Electron based software installations (Slack, Teams, Discord, etc.)

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\squirrel\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\update\\\.exe$")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-\\-processStart.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-\\-processStartAndWait.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-\\-createShortcut.*"))) AND  NOT ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Users\\\\.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Discord\\\\Update\\\.exe.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-\\-processStart.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*Discord\\\.exe.*")) OR ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Users\\\\.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\GitHubDesktop\\\\Update\\\.exe.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*GitHubDesktop\\\.exe.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-\\-createShortcut.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-\\-processStartAndWait.*"))) OR ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Users\\\\.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Microsoft\\\\Teams\\\\Update\\\.exe.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*Teams\\\.exe.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-\\-processStart.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-\\-createShortcut.*"))) OR ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Users\\\\.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\yammerdesktop\\\\Update\\\.exe.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*Yammer\\\.exe.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-\\-processStart.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-\\-createShortcut.*"))))
